subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be fixed as a narrow heartbeat wake precedence bug first, or should it also change Telegram private DMs away from the documented main-session default?
rationale: Source evidence supports the heartbeat precedence bug, but changing Telegram DM defaults would alter documented compatibility behavior for existing users.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Adopt or replace the linked fix so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins for event-triggered wakes while keeping Telegram DM defaults controlled by `session.dmScope`.

options.title: Bundle Telegram isolation
options.body: Change Telegram private DMs to isolate by default too, accepting the upgrade and documentation impact for users relying on main-session continuity.

options.title: Defer behind broader scheduling
options.body: Wait for native per-session heartbeat scheduling or a broader session-routing redesign, leaving this concrete bug unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Adopt or replace the linked fix so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins for event-triggered wakes while keeping Telegram DM defaults controlled by `session.dmScope`.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent mainline work touched the implicated heartbeat, exec, session-key, and Telegram conversation-route files, making this the strongest current routing owner signal.
